label: Local
note: Run in a Git repository with xec run inspect.ts. Commands use the selected local shell.

label: SSH
note: Replace the host and configure trusted host keys and authentication. SSH runs through Xec’s Node.js transport.

label: Docker
note: An image starts an ephemeral container. A container name targets an existing one. Requires a reachable Docker daemon.

label: Kubernetes
note: Select a real pod in your cluster. Requires kubectl and an authorized Kubernetes context.

label: Pipeline
note: Ready steps can run concurrently; dependencies gate execution. Package-level build graphs and artifact caches can remain in Turbo.

label: Terminal UI
note: Run in a terminal with xec run choose.ts. Installed Kit also runs with Bun. Cancellation is explicit.
